children.name: Policies and frameworks are strengthened for the sustainable management of natural resources, sustainable energy, climate resilience, and enhanced food security
01. Bahrain natural resources, and terrestrial and marine biodiversity are better protected, restored and sustainable use of ecosystems is promoted.

02. Climate Change adaptation and mitigation measures, resilience and adaptive capacity to climate-related hazards and natural disasters strengthened and integrated into national policies, strategies and planning.
03. Improve food security and nutrition across all population, through sustainable food production systems, resilient agriculture practices, and more efficient food supply networks.
Strengthened social sector policies and systems improve the delivery of quality, inclusive services* for Bahraini citizens and residents
children.description: Foster the notion of international protection among govermental stakeholders and Human Rights agencies in compliance with the International Refugee Law and other International legal instruments

children.name: 04. Relevant and effective learning outcomes are ensured, with a substantially increased supply of qualified teachers and enhanced access to quality education, including early childhood development.
05. Authorities and communities ensure healthy lives and promote well-being for all.
06. Bahrain cities and human settlements are more inclusive, safe, resilient and sustainable.

07. Relevant authorities have enhanced knowledge and capacity to deliver multi-sectoral programmes to increase social cohesion and protection to vulnerable groups, in line with a human rights-based approach.

framework.name: Economic diversification, public administration, and resilience

children.name: Enhanced policies and regulatory frameworks strengthen conditions for economic diversification, employment creation, rule of law, and increased resilience and innovation.

08. Economic diversification is strengthened through increase access of private sector, MSMEs and small-scale industrial enterprises to financial services, affordable credit, value chain integration and innovation that promote inclusive opportunities.
09. Relevant institutions promote development-oriented policies and tools that support productive activities, decent job creation, entrepreneurship, and access social protection measures for workers.
10. Authorities in Bahrain have enhanced capacities to ensure rule of law, access to justice, safety and security, and prevent crime, including trafficking in persons.

11. Relevant institutions have enhanced capacities to implement research and measure progress on sustainable development, through improved statistical capacity, use of enabling technology and e-governance, for better targeted public policies.
The Kingdom of Bahrain plays an enhanced role in international and regional partnerships for sustainable development, including peace and security initiatives, and to expand South-South cooperation
12. Government of Bahrain is supported for reporting and implementing international commitments and achieving greater international and regional relevance in the development agenda.
13. Civil Society Organizations, private sectors and relevant institutions are engaged in the promotion and advancement of the Sustainable Development Goals.

14. Relevant National institutions and CSOs, including Human Rights institutions are strengthened, including through international cooperation and capacity building, to promote and protect all human rights for all.
